name: cc-trans
description: Write and read in your own language while the model works in English: prompts go out translated, replies come back with a translation, code untouched. OMP port of midagedev/cc-trans.

language.description: The language you type and read in: a code (ko, ja, zh, es, de, ...) or its name. Empty: follow LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG.

engine.description: haiku = an omp model (see model); openai = any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; command = your own program, JSON over stdin/stdout.

view.description: How replies are shown. auto = interleave.

preview.description: Show the English of your draft above the prompt while you type; Enter then sends it with no wait.

model.description: Model for the haiku engine and fallback: provider/id, bare id or role alias.

openaiBaseUrl.description: For the openai engine, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.

openaiModel.description: For the openai engine, e.g. qwen3:8b.

openaiApiKey.description: For the openai engine; leave empty for a local server.

command.description: For the command engine: a program that reads {"from","to","lines"} JSON on stdin and prints {"lines"}.

fallback.description: Use the model engine when the openai or command engine fails.
